answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a refundable bond plus decaying entry rewards. Each agent must lock a bond to act, and every new identity draws from a shared nectar of pre-funded rewards whose per-identity share shrinks as identities multiply. New accounts also hold a low pearl of trust, so votes and attestations from them are discounted until they age and do real work. Attestations tracing to one funding harbor are correlated and collapsed into a single vote. Cost thus grows superlinearly while payout falls, so mass identity creation runs a net loss.
